## xAI Speech to Text v1 API

xAI Speech to Text v1 is a speech-to-text model by xAI, available on the Venice API as `stt-xai-v1`. Requests are anonymized, so the provider never sees your identity.

### xAI Speech to Text v1 API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `stt-xai-v1` | Standard | Anonymized | $0.1116 / audio hr |

### xAI Speech to Text v1 specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | xAI |
| Released | Apr 18, 2026 |
| Privacy | Anonymized |
| Status | Stable |

### How to use the xAI Speech to Text v1 API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/audio/transcriptions` with `"model": "stt-xai-v1"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/audio/transcriptions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -F model=stt-xai-v1 \
  -F file=@meeting.mp3
```
